senses.gloss: अभोज्य a. (f. ज्या) 1. Unfit for food, prohibited as food; 2. one whose food must not be eaten.
अभोज्य a. (f. ज्या) 1. Unfit for food, prohibited as food; 2. one whose food must not be eaten.

आभोग m. 1. Expanse, circuit, circumference, अकथितोऽपि ज्ञायत एव यथायमाभोगस्तपोवनस्येति Sak.i. (गण्डभोगात् ‘from the broad cheek’ Megh.ii.29); 2. effort; 3. the expanded hood of a cobra; 5. enjoyment, e.g. विषयाभोगेषु नैवादरः.
